master:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: master illustration for a professionally animated 2D anime talking puppet, isolated transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is an IDENTITY and COSTUME reference, not an edit target; draw a new beautiful illustration of exactly this original character named Glitch.
Primary request: a high resolution HALF-BODY front-facing character portrait, complete from antenna and ahoge to hoodie hem at waist; both relaxed arms and both small hands fully visible, separated slightly from torso. Character centered, upright, face level and directed exactly forward with gentle closed-mouth neutral smile. True transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no ground shadow, no checkerboard pattern drawn into pixels.
Identity: mint/cyan layered short bob ending in lavender tips, subtle glossy highlights and tiny pixel color flecks; sweeping fringe, one curved ahoge; two angular cyan/purple cyber antenna ornaments; exactly two purple bar hairclips on the VIEWER RIGHT. Large beautifully detailed teal irises with violet upper shading and bright reflections, dark plum lash lines, pale peach face, small cyan cheek-pixel marks. Dark slim choker.
Costume: oversized soft mint-to-lilac hoodie, lavender lining and dark plum-purple sleeve stripes, dark purple drawcords. Chest has a small dark display with exact red pixel text "ERROR" and a large pastel pixel cat directly beneath. Diagonal dark strap crosses from viewer-left shoulder to viewer-right waist; small translucent cyan/purple PCB pouch attached at the waist. Soft fabric folds, subtle pixel accents. Hoodie hem visible; no legs.
Style: exceptionally appealing polished Japanese anime key art, elegant delicate clean ink contours, refined soft cel shading, rich but soft pastel hues, cohesive original illustration. Human anime proportions rather than chibi, face not too round or infantile. Clear readable design and beautiful hair volume, restrained gradients, no 3D.
Composition: portrait 1024 by 1536 or larger comparable portrait, comfortable transparent margin above antennas and around hands, character fills canvas without any element cropped. Front-on symmetrical pose so it can become a 2D puppet.
Avoid: panels, labels, backgrounds, fake transparent checkerboard, UI, logos beyond required ERROR chest text, extra characters, dramatic pose, excessive floating pixels, disembodied hands, cropped antennas.
alphaCorrection:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: production transparent PNG cutout of the supplied master anime character.
Input image 1 is the edit target. KEEP the character illustration EXACTLY unchanged: same colors, ink, expression, shape, facial features, hair, antennas, both arms and hands, hoodie, lettering and pouch. Preserve the full 1024 by 1536 composition.
Change ONLY the background. The gray checkerboard currently behind the character is a WRONG baked background. Remove every background checker square and return an actual RGBA PNG whose background pixels have alpha 0. No visible background anywhere around the silhouette or in gaps between arms and torso. This task is PNG alpha background extraction, not illustration of transparency. Do not redraw any checkerboard or a checkerboard preview. Do not replace it with gray, black, white or scenery. All space not occupied by character must be genuinely transparent. Preserve fine hair edges and anti-aliasing. No drop shadow. No new text.
bodyHairAtlas:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: eight separate illustrated components on one 2D anime puppet production SPRITE ATLAS, landscape 3072 by 2048 pixels, 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows.
Input image 1 is the character IDENTITY, EXACT DESIGN and ART STYLE reference. Draw all parts newly to complete hidden surfaces for animation, while matching this beautiful original Glitch illustration exactly in linework, color, costume, proportions and soft cel shading.
BACKGROUND REQUIREMENT: use only perfectly flat, pure saturated RGB 0,255,0 chroma green in the empty background. Absolutely no checkerboard, gray, shadow, floor or gradients in the background. This is for chroma extraction. No green hue inside the illustrated character pieces; preserve mint/cyan and lavender design.
LAYOUT: eight isolated nonoverlapping parts centered in eight equal rectangular cells in a strict 4-column by 2-row order. Generous green gutters of at least 80 pixels around each part. NO labels, text labels, numbers, drawn grid lines, frames, panels, diagrams, assembled character, duplicates or sample previews. Every part completely inside its cell with no crop.
TOP ROW, left to right:
1. COMPLETE TORSO AND NECK, from long neck upper end to bottom hoodie hem. Include dark choker, neck skin, upper chest, completed shoulders, entire hoodie hood and body, plum lining, drawcords, "ERROR" chest display, pixel cat, diagonal strap and full PCB pouch. NO head, NO hair, NO arms, NO hands. Draw completed rounded shoulder underlaps and side torso surfaces hidden under the original sleeves.
2. VIEWER LEFT ARM: the character's right sleeve and hand, complete from round shoulder attachment to fingertips, slightly relaxed diagonal down and outward, matching reference mint/lavender puff sleeve and plum bands, cyan wrist device. No torso, no other parts.
3. VIEWER RIGHT ARM: the character's left sleeve and hand, complete from round shoulder attachment to fingertips, slightly relaxed diagonal down and outward, same garment and device. No torso, no other parts.
4. BACK HAIR: single completed thick back-of-head bob hair silhouette, rounded cyan crown and lavender-ended neck-length locks. FULL SOLID HAIR SHAPE including completed hidden crown and center behind face, without a face-shaped hole. NO face, NO eyes, NO ornaments, NO front bangs.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right:
5. BLANK FACE SKIN: completed front-facing anime head skin oval, tiny ears, slightly tapered chin, forehead extending high beneath hair. Same pale peach, blush and cyan pixel cheek markings, tiny nose highlight. ABSOLUTELY NO eyes, NO brows, NO eyelashes, NO mouth, NO hair or choker, no eye holes. Smooth completed unbroken face surface for overlaying separate features.
6. FRONT FRINGE AND ORNAMENTS: cyan crown, flowing central pointed fringe of reference, ahoge, both angular cyber antennas, and exactly two violet bar clips on viewer right. This is ONLY top-front hair and bangs as one part. Keep open empty space below fringe where face goes. NO face skin, NO eyes, NO neck, NO shoulder-length side locks.
7. VIEWER LEFT SIDE LOCKS: only flowing layered cyan-to-lavender left-side hair bundle from temple to neck, including front curl. Complete pointed ends and extended root for overlap. No face, no crown.
8. VIEWER RIGHT SIDE LOCKS: only flowing layered cyan-to-lavender right-side hair bundle from temple to neck. Complete pointed ends and extended root. No face, no crown.
Each piece must be a beautiful hand-drawn anime component with smooth complete outlines and sufficient illustrated overlap for puppet rotation. They must not look like jagged cutout fragments. Retain exact pastel lighting of reference; no realism or 3D.
faceFeaturesAtlas:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a production face-feature sprite atlas for an original 2D anime puppet, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, square 2048 by 2048 pixels.
Input image 1 is the reference for Glitch's exact face art style and color. These facial features will be composited onto a blank face; draw each feature as a SEPARATE isolated illustration, with no attached face skin and no head.
BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat pure RGB 0,255,0 chroma GREEN background. Absolutely no checkerboard or grid. No background shadow. No green hue inside the artwork. Leave generous empty green gutters between all components. Keep all art entirely inside cells. NO labels, letters, numbers, panel frames, grid lines, assembled faces, extra samples or decorations.
Style: match the master's beautiful polished clean anime ink, dark plum upper lashes, refined cyan-to-violet glossy eye shading, warm subtly tinted lower lid details. Neutral pleasant expression, front-facing left and right features paired symmetrically.
Twelve components in STRICT order:
ROW 1, left to right:
1. VIEWER LEFT OPEN EYE WHITE AND EYELASH OUTLINE, elegant dark plum upper and lower lash contours, complete clean white sclera filling almond aperture, tiny pale pink inner corner. ABSOLUTELY NO iris and NO pupil: center of eye remains pure clean white. NO eyebrow, NO skin patch.
2. VIEWER RIGHT OPEN EYE WHITE AND EYELASH OUTLINE, matching mirrored neutral almond shape, same complete white sclera. ABSOLUTELY NO iris or pupil. NO eyebrow or skin.
3. VIEWER LEFT IRIS ONLY: a tall oval detailed teal/cyan anime iris, darker violet upper third, dark plum pupil, luminous aqua lower ring and white star reflections. Full iris ellipse completed at top to slide beneath eye opening. No lashes, no sclera, no lid or skin.
4. VIEWER RIGHT IRIS ONLY: matching tall oval detailed iris with coherent same-direction lighting and reflections. No lashes, sclera, lid or skin.
ROW 2, left to right:
5. VIEWER LEFT EYEBROW ONLY: one fine pale plum relaxed gently arched eyebrow, elegant tapered ends, no skin.
6. VIEWER RIGHT EYEBROW ONLY: corresponding mirrored relaxed eyebrow, no skin.
7. VIEWER LEFT CLOSED EYELID ONLY: one beautiful dark plum curved closed lash line, soft slight upward smiling curve, fine eyelash taper at outer edge. No open eye, no sclera, no iris, no skin patch.
8. VIEWER RIGHT CLOSED EYELID ONLY: matching closed lash line, no skin patch.
ROW 3, left to right:
9. NEUTRAL CLOSED MOUTH ONLY: a tiny refined warm mauve almost-flat closed lip line with a subtle center highlight, absolutely no surrounding skin.
10. SOFT SMILING CLOSED MOUTH ONLY: slightly curved graceful mauve smile line with a tiny soft lower lip highlight, absolutely no surrounding skin.
11. SMALL OPEN TALKING MOUTH ONLY: a small clean upright oval open mouth, fine soft mauve rim, dark plum inner cavity and small peach-pink tongue at bottom, no teeth needed, no skin outside.
12. WIDER OPEN HAPPY TALKING MOUTH ONLY: small joyful open anime smile, wide soft oval mouth with dark plum cavity, a subtle upper ivory tooth edge and warm pink tongue, no surrounding skin.
Scale the two open eyes equally and generously within their cells; paired irises match approximately 60 percent the width of an open eye so they fit later. Brows and closed eyelids should be as wide as the eye outlines. Mouths about one third of an eye width; render them crisply even if smaller. This is an animation production atlas of separate features, not a study sheet of complete eyes or complete faces.
